description: CI-only settings for pipeline test directories, read by backendPipelines/ci/pipeline_tests.py. Keyed by repo-relative test directory. They live here, not in the pipeline folders, because CDK packages those folders as container build contexts and Lambda code, and a file there changes the deployed asset. extraRequirements are installed after the common and nearest requirements files, in one pip call: an entry '-r <repo-relative path>' names a requirements file, any other entry is a requirement line. headlessDisplay runs the suite under xvfb-run with the thumbnail image's rendering environment.

extraRequirements.reason: The Lambdas take Pillow from this pipeline's own layer, so the tests install that layer's requirements.

headlessDisplay.reason: The thumbnail tests render frames through PyVista/VTK (preview_pipeline/renderer.py), as the container does under Xvfb. Without a display VTK segfaults on the first render.
